verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance is a SaaS platform that stores customer records, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, data-deletion requests, or account-data purge capability. The only nearby mention is that API create, update, and delete operations need capabilities Harbor must explicitly grant. That is an access-permission gate on API resource operations, an adjacent control rather than user-controlled retention or deletion, so it earns no credit.
